models.label: ECMWF IFS 0.25°
models.note: ECMWF's operational physics model, open-data release. Its gust field is a maximum over the output interval, not an instantaneous value, so gust factors look large in light air.

models.label: ECMWF AIFS
models.note: ECMWF's machine-learning model - a genuinely independent opinion. Publishes no gust field, so gusts come from IFS and ICON-2i only.

models.label: ItaliaMeteo ICON-2i
models.note: ItaliaMeteo / ARPAE high-resolution model for Italy - the finest grid available here. Runs only ~60-72 h ahead and updates every 12 h, so it drops out of the longer-range view.

models.label: Météo-France MFWAM
models.note: Full sea-state decomposition - total wave, wind wave and swell with heights, directions and periods.

models.label: ECMWF WAM 0.25°
models.note: Total significant wave height only - used to cross-check MFWAM.

options.name: Portorosa Marina
options.shelter_note: Fully enclosed artificial marina basin - all-round shelter.

options.name: Porto Pignataro
options.shelter_note: Largest harbour in the Aeolians and the safest port in the group. Breakwatered; only a hard easterly sets any swell inside.

options.name: Marina Lunga / Porto Lipari
options.shelter_note: Town quay on the east coast. Fuel and water available. Open to the NE-SE quadrant and to ferry wash.

options.name: Valle Muria
options.shelter_note: Beautiful SW-facing bay, very safe anchoring in northerlies and easterlies. Untenable in anything from S through W.

options.name: San Pietro buoy field
options.shelter_note: Main buoy field off the port town on the east coast. Exposed to the NE-SE.

options.name: Drautto buoy field
options.shelter_note: Buoy field and anchoring south of San Pietro. Exposed to the E-SE.

options.name: Cala Zimmari
options.shelter_note: Black sand bay on the SE corner. Good in northerlies, rolly from the E and S.

options.name: Baia Milazzese
options.shelter_note: South-facing bay under the Bronze Age headland. Best shelter on Panarea in a northerly.

options.name: Marina del Gabbiano
options.shelter_note: Reserved buoys 600 m north of Scari on the east coast. DO NOT ANCHOR - the bottom is very rocky. Open to the whole northern-through-southeastern arc.

options.name: San Pietro buoy field

options.name: Drautto buoy field

options.name: Cala Zimmari
options.shelter_note: Black sand bay on the SE corner. Good in northerlies, rolly from the E and S.

options.name: Baia Milazzese

options.name: Filicudi Porto
options.shelter_note: Small port with limited dockage and mooring buoys on the NE side. Exposed N through ESE.

options.name: Pecorini a Mare

options.name: Rinella
